age.description:
How many consecutive builds this test has failed. Age gets reset to 0 if the status is set to "FIXED"
That is if age is a decently high number like 5, it is most likely a regression.

className.description:
The path of the test file this test function belongs to.
The path is separated by periods instead of slashes like a url.

duration.description: time in seconds to run the test

failedSince.description: Which build number the test started failing

name.description: Name of the test function (for platform) or description of the test (for apps).

skipped.description: Whether or not test was skipped

title: Information of a single test function within a test file.
name: JenkinsTestCase
